description: NaCaAl(SO₄)₃ crystallizes in the trigonal R3c space group. Na is bonded in a distorted hexagonal planar geometry to six O atoms. There are three shorter (2.41 Å) and three longer (2.80 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Ca is bonded to six O atoms to form CaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (2.17 Å) and three longer (2.24 Å) Ca-O bond lengths. Al is bonded to six O atoms to form AlO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra. All Al-O bond lengths are 2.00 Å. S is bonded to four O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent CaO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent AlO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 26-42°. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.45-1.52 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Ca and one S atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Al and one S atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ca, and one S atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Al, and one S atom.
